shared: Production-ready single transparent 2D videogame SPRITE SHEET, EXACTLY 8 illustrations, perfectly regular 4 columns x 2 rows. 4 distinct cels on the top row and 4 on the bottom; reading order left to right then next row. Each cell has equal width and height. Each entire sprite is isolated and centered with generous clear padding and nothing overlaps another cell. Same size in every cell, same side and angle; register the stationary body or base to the SAME point in each tile. Authentic detailed hand-placed 1990s arcade pixel art, Cap Dollar gritty hand-painted Metal Slug-like environments, chunky 1-to-2px clusters, limited atmospheric painterly palette with textured shadow and rim light, no vector, no photorealism. Color variation in stable structures minimal. Smooth consecutive cyclic subtle poses, 8 distinct hand animated phases, last flows into first. No labels, no borders, no scenery panels, no shadow on an imaginary ground, true transparent alpha.

sequences.obra: A heavy yellow and graphite construction concrete mixer, small portable industrial towable unit seen in strict side view. Mixer stands on its two low supports and wheels at the same floor line, with a tilted pear-shaped ribbed drum and its mouth at the upper left. Animate EIGHT phases of the rotating drum: distinctive rust patches and three painted diagonal white ribs travel around its axis, rim teeth advance and a fine trickle of dusty aggregate drops from the lip. Chassis, legs, mouth center, tire footprints and corrugated orange motor housing identical fixed anchors. No people, no ground. Background prop for a construction tower.
sequences.ruinas: One wary black raven in rightward sustained flight, readable side view and a slight three-quarter view of both wings. A single anatomically correct wingbeat cycle, frame 1 elevated open primaries, 2 rising apex, 3 broad power stroke forward, 4 level extended, 5 downstroke trailing, 6 low apex with fanned primaries, 7 tucked wrist recovery, 8 opening on upstroke. Same individual, beak pointing right, torso center anchored, far wing behind near wing and complementary silhouettes, dusty slate violet highlights and charcoal black plumage. Ruined city skyline prop.
sequences.aire: One distant small twin-engine 1940s cargo plane flying level TO THE RIGHT in side/three-quarter view. Long transport fuselage, olive-gray, coral faded rudder, blue cockpit glass, two propellers physically attached to engines, slim lights, no armament. Eight stages of its spinning propeller blades, localized glints on blades, a short flexible striped survey windsock cantilevered back from its tail rippling in a progressive wind wave; very stable body, center and wing shapes, moving propellers and streaming fabric clearly readable. Autonomous scenery near a giant airborne carrier.
sequences.moto: One rusty red-brown oilfield pumpjack, side elevation. Eight animation cels of one smooth 360-degree crank cycle and its mechanically linked nodding horsehead. FIXED triangular derrick and skid base, rear gearbox on left, counterweight crank on left turns and pitman joins it to walking beam pivot; curved horsehead on RIGHT rises and sinks with the vertical polished rod. Frames 1-8 progress 0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315 degrees, visible changes to the linkage not just illumination. Silhouette of a desert oilfield machine against transparent nothing, weathered steel and golden rim light.
sequences.agua: A single blue-green manta ray gliding to the RIGHT, side/three-quarter view just above the animal looking down enough to distinguish near and far pectoral fins, head at right, tapering tail trailing to the left. Make 8 anatomically connected phases of a slow full undulating swimming stroke: wing roots lead then fin rays and pointed tips follow, thin tail curves with delayed S wave, stable torso placement, ventral pale aqua edge, dappled highlights deep teal dorsal skin. Each phase clearly different; alternating near and far silhouettes. No water, bubbles or surrounding scenery.
sequences.centro: One charming vintage coin-operated mechanical horse on a stationary spring rocker outside an arcade store. Broadside FACING LEFT. Original retro mall decor with worn brass saddle rails, faded terracotta-red saddle, muted cream and teal enamel horse, charcoal metal spring linkage and bolted rectangular burgundy plinth. 8 different phases of a single smooth mechanical rocking gallop; horse nose pitches up then down and body rises and falls with compressing spring linkage anchored to SAME base, mane and leather reins trail a little. Identical coin box on plinth, warm shop lighting. No rider, no lettering.
sequences.espacio: One asymmetric low-orbit weather satellite, weathered gray and brass cylindrical bus, two blue-violet segmented photovoltaic wings and a small off-axis copper mesh communications dish, a short projecting aerial and glowing cyan status light. Fixed bus center, consistent design, sun at upper left. No planets or stars.
sequences.york: One classic NYC steam street vent assembly, a low wide rusty iron grating in ground perspective, aged orange and ivory striped SHORT temporary steam chimney on right of the grating with a chipped dark elbow and bolted collar. Eight frame looping animation of a clearly readable curling, rising, breaking and dissipating column of dusty gray-blue steam, backlit at edges. Plume distinct shapes through cycle, secondary smaller wisps and moisture droplets. Street grate, base, elbow fixed in every frame. Object designed to be set on the sidewalk of an arcade pixel Manhattan, no street or floor painted.
sequences.quimera: Small dockside diesel forklift carrying two lashed wooden cargo crates on its forks, strict side view FACING RIGHT.
